title: DE/F5: manifest parser missing from the read-time-diagnostic and fuzz surfaces — Raise to SO
description: The manifest becomes an adopter-editable governed artifact consumed by the session-substrate check (Layer 2). The contract's Trust boundaries enumerate read-failure discipline (diagnostic never panic, every kind) for config, state, and the vocabulary registry; the Phase 5 fuzz scope names config, state, registry, substrate-settings, and tracker-payload parsers. The installed-artifact manifest parser is in neither list by name — whether 'registry' is read to cover templates/registry/ artifacts generally or only the vocabulary registry is an SO ruling. Ask: extend both enumerations to name the manifest parser (a small amendment candidate at the next amendment window, or an SO reading recorded on this issue). Owner: data-engineer. Validator: solution-owner (DESIGN change authority routing).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Round-1 convergence joins this issue's scope (SO lens 3.1 + 3.2): the statusline repo-set config (~/.config/vsdd/statusline.yaml, statusline-data.md:51-55) is a second adopter-edited parseable surface in the same class as the manifest parser — raised here so one SO ruling covers both: extend the Trust-boundaries read-failure discipline and Phase-5 fuzz scope to name both parsers, or record the reading that 'registry'/'adopter-edited files' covers them generally. The round-1 solution-owner lens flags shipping first-publish with this undecided as front-running (contract line 81).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OPERATOR RULING (2026-07-21, round-1 triage — the parked Solution Owner reading, now ruled): the installed-artifact manifest parser and the statusline repo-set config parser join BOTH the read-time-diagnostic enumeration and the fuzz-scope enumeration BY NAME. Explicit naming beats a broad adopter-edited-files reading that would silently widen the fuzz scope. Small amendment; text lands at the round-1 amendment window with the gate rulings.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Ruling recorded above (both parsers named into the read-time-diagnostic and fuzz enumerations); the amendment text rides #698 with the other six touches. Closing — the parked Solution Owner reading is done.
